content: better-auth 1.7.3 (Sep 2026). Default hashing scrypt; custom bcrypt via emailAndPassword.password.{hash,verify}. cookieCache {enabled,maxAge} gives signed compact cookie so proxy checks skip DB. Drizzle adapter: drizzleAdapter(db,{provider:'pg',schema}) with modelName/fields mapping onto existing users table. admin() plugin adds role/banned fields, defaultRole. advanced.database.generateId custom/false. Peer pins: next ^16, drizzle-orm ^0.45.2, drizzle-kit >=0.31.4. NextAuth guide: credentials -> account rows providerId 'credential', account.password column; emailVerified becomes boolean (existing timestamp col needs backfilled boolean col).
